class.name: ArkherQualityPreset
class.brief_description: A saved quality profile for [ArkherQualityDirector] — one per target device.
class.description: A [Resource] holding a complete quality calibration: target FPS, dynamic-resolution bounds, upscaler, the per-tier rendering arrays and the thermal-ceiling rates of the [ArkherQualityDirector]. Create one preset per target device (e.g. [code]presets/a70.tres[/code] for the Itel A70, [code]presets/top.tres[/code] for a flagship) and load it at runtime with [method ArkherQualityDirector.apply_preset]. This is how a solo dev calibrates the Arkher pillar 1 ("photoreal on any phone") without hardcoding per-device values. In stable Godot builds (no Arkher module), the equivalent script-based class is [code]ArkherQualityProfile[/code] from the [code]arkher_quality[/code] addon.

members.member: Target frames per second. The director lowers the render scale until this FPS is sustained.
Minimum render scale (0.4 = 40% of the resolution).
Maximum render scale. On a floor-tier device (e.g. the Itel A70) keep this below 1.0 — the phone should not even try to render at full resolution.
Up-scaling filter used to restore the screen resolution. [constant ArkherQualityDirector.UPSCALER_AUTO] picks FSR in the Arkher engine.
FSR sharpness (0 = smooth, 1 = sharper). Only used when the upscaler is FSR or FSR2.
Shadow on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code] (0 = off, 1 = on).
Maximum shadow distance in meters per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code].
Environment reflections (planar/SDF) on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code] (0 = off, 1 = on).
SDFGI on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code] (0 = off, 1 = on).
SSAO on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code] (0 = off, 1 = on).
SSIL on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code] (0 = off, 1 = on).
Glow on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code] (0 = off, 1 = on).
Volumetric fog on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code] (0 = off, 1 = on).
SSR on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code] (0 = off, 1 = on).
How fast the director's thermal state rises under sustained load (per second, 0..1 scale). Calibrate per device: lower for phones with weak coolers (e.g. the Itel A70), higher for flagships.
How fast the thermal state falls when the frame budget is met (per second, 0..1 scale).
Thermal state at which the effective max scale starts being lowered (0..1). At full heat the max scale is halved.
